description: Windows system-tray utility showing battery levels for wireless mice, headsets, keyboards, and controllers.
notes: Uses the official portable ZIP, containing BatteryHub.exe and the bundled headsetcontrol.exe helper. The installer is not run.
This is the current upstream application name starting with v1.1.0; wireless-battery is retained as a pinned legacy manifest for v1.0.8.

Battery history and update files are stored under %LOCALAPPDATA%\WirelessBattery; optional language files are stored under %APPDATA%\WirelessBattery\lang. These user-data directories are outside the Scoop application directory and remain after Scoop uninstall.
The portable application supports --demo for synthetic sample devices and --quit to close an already running instance.
